needs.motivation: Each generation has narrowed the gap; sustaining open-weight leadership and price-performance pressure on the closed frontier rewards continuing the climb.

needs.job: Promote and harden faster execution paths so large open-weight coding models run efficiently on local and self-hosted hardware, removing the deployment tax.

needs.motivation: Defaulting the fast path drives adoption of the engine and proves open weights are deployable, reinforcing the open-weight value proposition.

needs.job: Ship a unified 4-bit scheme that holds near-FP16 accuracy on large MoE weights, making the open coding model affordable to run and re-verify yourself.
